title: OSI COTP: Set src-ref and dst-ref from CR and CC TPDUs
description:
Class 0 and 1 COTP, which are what is carried over TPKT and typically
encountered these days, do not carry the src-ref and dst-ref, but rely
on them being known from the Connect Request and Connect Confirm TPDUs
(similar to the SYN and SYN-ACK.) Store them.
